Hand bone minus 12mm is an explicit sleeve-end construction datum, not an anatomical wrist boundary.
failure_attribution: The v2 seam equivalence graph is intrinsically manifold; the failed operation is this 3D initial placement, not mismatched 2D seam lengths.
A common shoulder boundary closes all samples, but the adjacent body surface parameterizations fold across each other near the shoulder; exact union alone does not make the interior embedding valid.
Different front-panel interior maps produce overlapping front-sheet crossings despite the disclosed 5mm nominal layer offset.
The two-piece sleeve centerline changes its local cross-section frame at the elbow and folds sleeve_front_L near that transition.
One proper crossing also occurs within the attached collar near its shoulder turn.
final_boundary_meaning: Open wrap garment: neckline, free lapel edges and hem are one connected boundary; wrists are separate circular boundaries. Attached collar changes that first loop from176 to180 edges.
stop_contract: Fixed REST first-piece failed embedding safety. No second parameter version, solver, relaxation, binding/export, renderer, or production injection is authorized from this failed mesh.
